name: crot-desktop
description: Restaurant POS Desktop - Electron shell around the existing web UI.
author: CROT

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c green,blue "npm --prefix ../web run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-build.js && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-build.js && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && node scripts/prepare-build.js && node scripts/run-electron-builder.js --win
